verdict.rationale: Clerky offers document collaboration features—real-time co-editing, customizable key terms, attorney review/comment loop-in, and audit logs of changes ([clerky-docs-11],[clerky-docs-12],[clerky-docs-13],[clerky-docs-4])—which support a controlled, non-email workflow. However, this applies only to Clerky's own templated startup-formation document sets (incorporation, SAFEs, stock plans), not general-purpose contract drafting/negotiation with redlining across arbitrary contract types or external counterparties. Missing for 10: dedicated redline/track-changes tooling, support for negotiating contracts outside Clerky's own templates, evidence of external-party negotiation workflows, and independent confirmation of the collaboration features in practice.
